sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: The August 17 outage, and the work ahead
items.blurb: An update on the August 17 outage and the steps we're taking to improve reliability. The post The August 17 outage, and the work ahead appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
items.blurb: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model.

items.title: The next generation of MCP
items.blurb: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

items.title: Say it once: introducing Bot Preference Sync
items.blurb: Cloudflare's new Bot Preference Sync automatically aligns your robots.txt file with your AI bot policies for Search, Agent, and Training. Easily manage which bots access your content without maintaining static files.

items.title: A Tale of Two Flink Autoscalers
From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent
items.blurb: Cloudflare OAuth now supports optional scopes, giving users more control over what an app can access and helping developers build secure consent flows around the task at hand.

items.title: Building Jarvis Pro: Route first, answer later
items.blurb: Introduction The first Jarvis Pro prototype could produce answers that sounded right. That was the problem.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work
items.blurb: If you’re juggling multiple Copilot sessions, use the My work pane to track what's in flight, what's done, and what's next. The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
